svg.title: Protocol Gateway architecture, variant A: three columns
svg.desc: OT devices such as PLCs, robots and machine tools connect over OT protocols to the Protocol Gateway, which runs in a Docker container on a Linux edge device. Its MQTT client publishes to the local MQTT broker. thin-edge.io (agent and Cumulocity mapper) uses the same broker, and the broker's bridge connects to Cumulocity over encrypted MQTT.
